answer: Re-attestations are stored in beacon and horizon lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the onyx graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 685 impostors cost 1989 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
